Architecture and form from the original ECS product images and their close-ups (the hero image leads where they disagree); component dimensions from the production sheets
where they exist. 170 cm S–M wearer form, upright posture. Where the images and the sheets disagree, r3 follows the images and records the difference (sheet 3).
